subject: small low heap of old human bones on a stone floor, a skeleton long since kicked apart: thigh bones and shin bones with knobbed joint ends lying across each other, some snapped in half with jagged broken ends, a few curved ribs, a pelvis half buried, a lower jaw, vertebrae and a shard of skull, grit and stone dust gathered at its foot; real human bone anatomy; aged bone, dirty ivory to tobacco brown, darker and earth-stained underneath, grey dust over it, matte and dry, never white
